objective: Load one bounded attributed relationship economics view set and derive several acquisition aggregate dimensions from that same in-memory cohort without repeating persistence reads.
rules: Relationship views are loaded exactly once per snapshot request.
All requested dimensions are pure projections over the same loaded view set.
Requested dimensions are validated through the existing aggregate projection.
Duplicate requested dimensions are removed while preserving first-request order.
Empty dimension input returns an empty aggregate set after one canonical view load.
RelationshipCount reflects the canonical deduplicated view set returned by the attributed economics batch application.
Currency isolation remains owned by INS-003H.
Premium remains distinct from River revenue.
Realized commission and contribution semantics remain owned by the canonical relationship and aggregate analytics layers.
No snapshot or aggregate result is persisted.
